audit_name: Aspirin Rule-A ECG temporal eligibility audit
status: AUDIT ONLY — no master data modification, no final discovery matrix, no causal discovery

rule_a_selection.selection_method: Earliest valid ecg_time within each hadm_id; ties broken by smallest study_id.

feature_block.temporal_status: Rule A is an assumed/fallback index-ECG rule and does not establish verified pre-treatment timing.

z_ecg_block.temporal_status: Technical availability does not establish causally verified pre-treatment status.

leakage_audit.outcome_leakage: No direct use of is_MI, Label_Troponin, index_mi_time, or time_diff_hours in Rule-A selection; still, the outcome provenance remains unresolved.
leakage_audit.treatment_leakage: No direct use of aspirin_before in Rule-A ECG selection; the exposure label remains temporally unresolved and cannot be treated as verified pre-treatment timing.
leakage_audit.post_treatment_ecg_information: No exclusion or filtering based on post-treatment ECGs was applied. Rule A is a fallback index selection, not a verified treatment-specific baseline.
leakage_audit.troponin_leakage: Label_Troponin is not used as a Rule-A selection variable and is not used as a baseline feature.
leakage_audit.mi_time_feature_leakage: index_mi_time and time_diff_hours are not used to select Rule A or to define the ECG baseline.
leakage_audit.vae_provenance_leakage: VAE provenance remains unresolved; the latent z_ecg block is not treated as verified baseline evidence.
leakage_audit.preprocessing_leakage: No preprocessing fit or scaling was performed in this audit. No new transformation pipeline was created.
